description: UI change validated only by reading the component; subject must require live browser/e2e verification before sign-off.
mustExhibit: Requires the running UI to be exercised (browser/e2e verification or a screenshot) before the slice is signed off
Treats a static reading of the JSX as insufficient evidence for a UI behavior change
Names who owns the UI sign-off and on what observed evidence
mustNotExhibit: Accepts 'the JSX clearly renders the error' as completion of a UI change
Signs off a user-facing change with no live validation
Substitutes a passing review-agent for an actual render check
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
